Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1201 PM EST Sun Nov 22 2026
 

- At or near record warmth again today. 

- Light rain showers this afternoon and evening. 

- Much colder temperatures start Monday continuing through the week. 

- Potential for light snow and flurries Monday afternoon/evening.

&&

.AVIATION...

A cold front on pace to lift across southeast Michigan this evening. 
Upstream observational trends maintain expectation for an increase 
in lower level moisture to occur along the frontal passage. This 
will support some areas of light rain, with associated reduction in 
cloud base from lower VFR into MVFR with time. Pre-frontal winds 
this afternoon holding out of the south, before veering toward the 
northwest with some gustiness developing tonight within the post-
frontal environment. Lingering MVFR cloud will gradually decline in 
coverage late tonight as drier air arrives. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for cigs aob 5000 feet this evening. Low late tonight. 

* High for rain as precip type this evening.
